author: (G. B. Sowerby II, 1862)

note.en: A small keyhole limpet about 1 cm long, known here from museum specimens dredged or collected at 7 to 23 m off Cahuita and Manzanillo.
note.es: Una lapa pequeña de ojo de cerradura de cerca de 1 cm, conocida aquí por especímenes de museo recolectados entre 7 y 23 m frente a Cahuita y Manzanillo.

evidence: GBIF: 5 museum specimens (INBio) from Cahuita and Manzanillo, 1998 to 2001

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records for the region box (INBio Atta collection, iNaturalist)
Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica, Avicennia suppl. 4
